meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Phase 08.1 Cross-Platform Brand Consistency & Accessibility QA

platforms.web_desktop: PASS — locked App Shell, horizontal identity, keyboard-accessible complex maps
platforms.web_mobile: PASS WITH RULE — compact identity, 200% reflow, provenance/state retained
platforms.ios: PASS WITH RULE — safe areas, Dynamic Type, >=44x44pt targets, Reduce Motion, SF Symbols only for generic actions
platforms.android: PASS WITH RULE — insets/cutouts, large font, 48x48dp preferred, motion preferences, system icons only for generic actions

themes: PASS WITH RULE — dark/light preserve Phase 02 semantics, never literal inversion
production_rules: One logo geometry across Web, iOS and Android; masks/safe areas/chrome never redraw it.
Semantic color, domain icon, map-state, motion and provenance meaning remain invariant across platforms.
Mobile compaction never removes evidence, provenance, verification, warning or state retrievability.
Web 200% zoom, iOS Dynamic Type and Android large-font scaling reflow; fixed-height clipping is prohibited.
System icons are limited to generic OS actions; Dấu Việt domain semantics retain Phase 04 glyphs.
Reduced motion removes high-motion behavior rather than merely accelerating it.
Dark/light themes preserve Phase 02 contrast/state semantics; literal palette inversion is prohibited.
Platform map gestures cannot remove required keyboard/screen-reader/accessible-list alternatives.
Locale behavior follows Phase 03; font fallback must not collapse SC/TC/JP/KR distinctions.
Launch/splash/brand animation never gates navigation, auth recovery, deep links or essential content.
Store screenshots/promotional media obey Phase 07 truth rules; fabricated states/wrong-entity imagery are prohibited.
Platform adaptation may change mechanics/density but not locked hierarchy or semantic priority without approved UX change.
